name: cat_collector_food_gains_three_and_makes_a_cat
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.") Whenever you gain life for the first time during each of your turns, create a 1/1 white Cat creature token.' Cat Collector enters: one Food. On seat 0's turn it pays {2}, taps and sacrifices the Food: it gains 3 life, its first life gain this turn, so one Cat token is created. The Food is gone. (act:card:13:0 is the Food, the card made after the setup card and the twelve library fillers.)
